Puedes probar los tres pasos de la porta: You can try the three steps on the home page without an account. Demo changes are temporary. Sign in or create an account to save your own space.
Crea tu cuenta con un usuario y una cont: Create an account with a username and a password of 8 to 128 characters. Confirm the password and accept the terms. No email is required. Usernames are always stored and checked in lowercase.
El botón del ojo muestra u oculta la con: The eye button shows or hides your password. Keep it somewhere safe: password recovery is not available. Remember me for 30 days is optional; avoid using it on shared devices.
Mis diseños muestra tus proyectos y las: My designs shows your projects and invitations you have accepted. Select a card to open it. The trash button deletes a design you own; check its name before confirming.
Los ajustes de la aplicación permiten ca: Application settings let you change the language and prepare offline use. The Information menu to their right contains this guide, the privacy notice and the terms of use.
La cuenta y sus diseños se eliminan tras: Your account and designs are deleted after at least three calendar months without authenticated activity on the server. Working only offline does not renew that period.
Biblioteca de diseños con el botón Nuevo: Design library with the New design button and the settings and information menus.
Desde la biblioteca puedes abrir un dise: Use the library to open a design, create another one or access settings.
Toca un elemento de la escena o de la li: Select an item in the scene or the Items list. Use Move or Rotate in the selection toolbar and drag the colored handles. Edit opens its numeric properties.
En móvil, abre solo el panel que necesit: On mobile, open the panel you need and close it with the X to make more space for the viewer. Add stays in the viewer's top toolbar when panels are closed.
Los muebles pueden superponerse o salir: Furniture can overlap or extend outside the room while editing. Translucent red indicates a position to review; it does not block movement. Grid snapping moves in increments and can be disabled in View options → Movement.
Para crear una puerta o ventana, indica: To create a door or window, choose a wall and enter its dimensions, including height. For windows, set Height from floor to position the lower edge. The entire opening must fit in the wall without overlapping another opening.
Las puertas pueden abrir a la derecha, a: Doors can open to the right, to the left, or use Frame only. Select an opening and drag it toward another wall to move it there. You can also set its wall and position in properties.
En las propiedades de un mueble puedes c: Furniture properties let you change size, position, rotation, material and color, or delete the item. Deleting furniture does not generate replacement decorations.
Editor con un mueble seleccionado, contr: Editor with selected furniture, movement handles and the properties panel.
Selecciona en la escena y usa los contro: Select an item in the scene and use its handles or panel values to position it.
Selecciona el piso para elegir madera, l: Select the floor to choose wood, tiles, staggered tiles, checkerboard, marble or concrete, as well as its color.
Selecciona un mueble para cambiar su aca: Select furniture to change its finish to wood, plastic or metal. Imported models can keep their original materials or use a custom finish. Fabrics, mirrors and other catalog components keep their specific materials.
El color y la luz son aproximaciones vis: Color and light are visual approximations that depend on your screen. Hyperrealistic mode does not replace lighting calculations or physical paint samples.
En Luz puedes activar el sol y ajustar h: In Light, enable sunlight and adjust the time, direction and intensity. Shadows and incoming light depend on openings and open doors.
Selecciona un foco para cambiar su posic: Select a light to change its position, intensity in lumens and color temperature. Use its switch to turn it on or off.
Pulsa Recorrer para entrar al cuarto y S: Select Walk through to enter the room and Exit to return to the exterior view. Drag over the scene to look around.
En computadora, camina con WASD o las fl: On desktop, walk with WASD or the arrow keys; Q and E turn your view, and R and F tilt it. On touch screens, move the joystick to walk and drag elsewhere to look around.
Toca una puerta o un foco para abrir, ce: Select a door or light to open, close or switch it on or off. You can also use the button that appears when looking at it, or press Enter or Space. Dragging to look does not activate items.
El recorrido respeta las paredes y objet: Walkthrough movement respects walls and objects. In a public link or embedded viewer, trying doors and lights is temporary and does not change the saved design.
Crear elemento abre el taller. También p: Create item opens the workshop. You can also select existing furniture and use Edit model to start from it. Saving creates a new model and keeps the original.
En Agregar, elige Formas para usar primi: In Add, choose Shapes for primitives, Pieces for boards, legs and other components, or Furniture to start from a catalog model.
Selecciona una pieza en el visor o en Pi: Select a part in the viewer or the Pieces panel. Move, Rotate and Size activate its handles. In Edit, enter its dimensions and position, change its name and choose a material and color.
Activa Snap con el imán cuando necesites: Enable Snap with the magnet when you need precision. In Align → Snapping options, choose grid or part snapping and the movement and rotation increments. Disable it to move freely.
Para alinear sin arrastrar, elige la pie: To align without dragging, choose the part to move and a reference in Align with. Select Width, Height or Depth, then an edge, the center or a contact option. The reference part stays in place.
Activa Seleccionar varias y toca las pie: Enable Select multiple and select the parts you need. On desktop, you can also use Shift, Ctrl or Cmd. Group lets you move, rotate, align or duplicate the set. Ungroup restores individual parts; the pencil lets you edit one part inside a group.
Para combinar dos piezas, selecciona una: To combine two parts, select one part and open Edit → Combine with another piece. Choose the second part and an operation: Union keeps both volumes, Subtract removes the second from the first, and Intersection keeps the shared region.
Pulsa Ver resultado para revisar una ope: Select Preview result to inspect a boolean operation. Apply confirms the change and Cancel keeps the previous parts. Part order matters when subtracting; check the preview description.
Geometría permite modificar vértices y c: Geometry lets you change a part's vertices and faces. Choose the type, change coordinates, or add and delete components. Start with dimensions and simple shapes before editing the mesh.
Deshacer y Rehacer permiten revisar camb: Undo and Redo let you review workshop changes. Use Save model or Save copy to finish. The result is saved as a GLB and added to the design.
En Agregar → Modelos propios puedes subi: In Add → Custom models, upload a static GLB up to 20 MB with embedded PNG or JPEG textures. This design shows its models; My models lets you copy a model from another design you own. The copy is independent of the original.
Los GLB con animaciones, recursos extern: GLBs with animations, external resources or unsupported compression are rejected. If a model exceeds geometry, texture or storage limits, reduce it before uploading.
Taller de modelos con piezas de un muebl: Model workshop with furniture parts and selection, snapping and alignment controls.
Construye con piezas sencillas y usa sel: Build with simple parts and position them using multiple selection, snapping and alignment.
Guarda y sincroniza el diseño antes de a: Save and sync the design before opening Share. Only the owner can manage access. Sharing is unavailable in offline mode.
En Personas, escribe el nombre de un usu: In People, enter an existing username and choose Viewer or Editor. Select Invite. The other person receives a bell notification and must accept the invitation.
Un lector puede consultar y recorrer el: A viewer can view and walk through the design. An editor can change it with you. The owner can change roles or remove access from the people list.
Crear enlace habilita un acceso público: Create link enables public viewing without an account. Anyone who receives the link can see the design. Disable link prevents new public reads; it does not erase previously downloaded copies.
En Insertar, copia el enlace del visor o: In Embed, copy the viewer link or iframe code for another website. This viewer shows only the scene, walkthrough and three visual modes. The public link must remain enabled.
Los diseños con colaboración o enlace pú: Designs with collaboration or public links require a connection for editing. To work on them offline, create a personal copy from the library while connected. The copy has no collaborators and does not change the original.
El visor público muestra lo sincronizado: The public viewer shows the version synced to the server. Changes saved only on your device are not shared yet.
Panel Compartir con invitaciones a usuar: Share panel with user invitations and viewer or editor role selection.
Invita por nombre de usuario y asigna el: Invite by username and assign the access each person needs.
Con conexión, entra a tu cuenta y abre A: While connected, sign in and open Settings → Offline from the library or editor. Select Prepare designs and wait until Application and Designs and models are available.
Activa Modo sin conexión para trabajar l: Enable Offline mode to work locally, even with an internet connection. The choice persists after closing and reopening and is shared across that account's tabs.
Puedes abrir la biblioteca, crear y edit: You can open the library, create and edit designs, draw floor plans, import projects, create models and walk through rooms. Changes are not sent and notifications are not checked. Sharing and collaboration stay disabled.
Cuando quieras enviar tus cambios, vuelv: When you want to send your changes, reconnect and disable offline mode. The app checks your account and permissions and syncs all pending work, including closed designs and models not yet placed in a room.
Si la sesión venció, puedes seguir usand: If your session expires, you can keep using and downloading your local work. Sign back into the same account to sync. Keep the app open until pending changes finish syncing.
Para instalarla, usa Instalar 3D Space s: To install, use Install 3D Space if it appears in Settings, or your browser's install option. On iPhone or iPad, open Safari's Share menu and choose Add to Home Screen.
Prepara el dispositivo antes de quedarte: Prepare your device before going offline. Your browser may erase data or run out of storage: keep a downloaded copy of important work. Offline work does not renew your account's inactivity period.
Ajustes con preparación de diseños, modo: Settings with design preparation, offline mode, storage and updates.
Comprueba disponibilidad y cambios pendi: Check availability and pending changes before enabling offline mode.
Los cambios válidos se guardan automátic: Valid changes are saved automatically. Check the save indicator: saved on this device does not always mean the server has received the changes. Do not clear browser data while you have pending work.
Si aparece un conflicto, descarga primer: If a conflict appears, download your changes first. You can recover work as an independent copy or choose Use saved version to keep the server version. Review which version you need before closing or dismissing the notice.
Si falta un recurso o no termina una des: If an asset is missing or a download does not finish, use Retry once connected. Incomplete preparation is not marked as available. If storage is full, free space unrelated to your designs and prepare again.
Si un campo obligatorio queda vacío o co: If a required field is empty or invalid, you can finish typing before leaving the field. The app keeps the last valid value when it cannot save the new input. Check the notice next to the field.
Antes de cerrar sesión, sincroniza o des: Sync or download pending work before signing out. App updates wait for local saves to be confirmed; do not close other tabs with unsaved work to force an update.
Los respaldos del servidor no incluyen c: Server backups do not include changes you have not synced. This guide cannot guarantee browser data retention or that a backup will recover changes made after its date.

En Mis diseños, pulsa Nuevo diseño. La p: In My designs, select New design. Setup has four optional steps: Sketch, Roof, Colors and Furniture. The editor opens when you finish.
En Croquis, escribe el nombre y las dime: In Sketch, enter a name and dimensions in meters. Use the initial plan or add walls and rooms on the grid. The Level selector lets you prepare each story of the building.
En Cubierta, elige una forma plana, a un: In Roof, choose a flat, shed, gable or hip shape. Set dimensions, slope and finishes. You can edit vertices and faces to create a custom shape.
En Colores, selecciona paredes, piso o t: In Colors, select walls, floor or ceiling and choose their finishes. In Furniture, add furniture, doors, windows and lights. Doors and windows are added manually.
Continuar avanza, Atrás permite revisar: Continue moves forward, Back lets you review, and Skip keeps the work you have already done in that step. Skip never resets the design. If you leave, use Continue setup in the library.
Si no cambias nada, empiezas con una pla: Without changes, you start with a 5 × 4 m plan, white walls and a flat white roof, a white floor and one main light. No furniture, doors or windows are generated.
Preparación del diseño con cuatro pasos: Design setup with four steps and a level selector.
Croquis, Cubierta, Colores y Decoración: Sketch, Roof, Colors and Furniture can be skipped without losing changes.
Abre Planta para trabajar sobre la cuadr: Open Floor plan to work on the grid. Select lets you choose objects, walls, corners and slab openings. Wall draws segments: select the start and then each endpoint; Finish confirms the drawing.
Habitación → Rectángulo necesita dos esq: Room → Rectangle needs two opposite corners. Free outline lets you mark another shape and close the outline. New rooms are added to the existing construction.
Las paredes se dividen en sus intersecci: Walls split at intersections, and doors and windows keep their wall references when the split permits it. A split cannot cut through an opening.
Ajustar a cuadrícula coloca puntos por p: Snap to grid places points in increments. Straight lines restricts direction to multiples of 15°, 30°, 45° or 90°. Length fixes the next segment length; leave it blank to draw freely.
Arrastra una esquina para mover el punto: Drag a corner to move that point and its connected walls, or enter its coordinates. Drag a wall to move its endpoints. Split wall adds a midpoint junction; Delete wall also removes its doors and windows.
Habitación → Hueco crea una abertura en: Room → Opening creates a hole in the floor. Draw its outline inside a surface and finish. Select the hole to adjust its corners or delete it; stair-linked holes are removed with their staircase.
En móvil, usa dos dedos para desplazar y: On mobile, use two fingers to pan and zoom the plan. On desktop, the wheel changes zoom. Close panels when you need more drawing space.
Enter termina, Retroceso retira el últim: Enter finishes, Backspace removes the last point, and Escape cancels. Undo construction and Redo construction handle a complete operation. Invalid dimensions or intersections leave the previous construction intact.
El selector Nivel aparece en la preparac: The Level selector appears in setup and the editor. Choose the story you want to edit. Level options lets you change its name and height. Elevation is calculated from the heights below it; a project supports up to 12 levels.
Nivel vacío crea una losa sin paredes, m: Empty level creates a slab without walls, furniture, doors, windows or lights. Copy structure below copies the plan and walls without duplicating furniture, doors, windows or lights. Review the top roof after adding a story.
Eliminar nivel retira su contenido, esca: Delete level removes its contents, connecting stairs and associated slab openings. Check the name before confirming. A project always keeps at least one level.
En Opciones de vista → Visibilidad, elig: In View options → Visibility, choose Full, Cut away or Hidden walls and toggle Show roofs. Visible levels offers Active level, Levels below and Whole building.
Ocultar paredes o cubiertas cambia la pr: Hiding walls or roofs changes presentation, not construction or walkthrough collisions. Items are added to the active level.
Más opciones reúne descanso, espesor del: More options contains landing depth, tread thickness and railings. For a spiral staircase, you can also change the inner and outer radii, total turn angle and direction. Stair finish controls color and material.
La escalera propone un hueco real en el: A staircase proposes a real opening in the upper floor. It must fit within a surface without overlapping other openings. In Floor plan, select that hole and move its corners; the adjusted shape is kept as your own choice.
Si no cabe, revisa las medidas del espac: If it does not fit, review the space dimensions, shape and parameters before adding it again. Incompatible dimensions keep the last valid construction. Delete staircase also removes its associated slab opening.
Recorrer permite subir y bajar continuam: Walk through lets you move continuously up and down. Walls, doors, furniture, slabs and the roof underside limit movement and headroom.
Las comprobaciones geométricas sirven pa: Geometry checks are for visualizing spaces. They do not replace structural design, building regulations or professional review.
En Cubierta durante la preparación, o Cu: In Roof during setup, or Room → Roofs in the editor, select a roof or use Add roof. Shape offers Flat, Shed, Gable and Hip; the latter needs a rectangular base.
Set width, length, height and slope. More options contains overhang, orientation and thickness. Exterior finish and Interior finish let you choose color and material separately.
Editar forma convierte la plantilla en u: Edit shape converts the template into a mesh. Choose a vertex and change X, Y or Z. You can add vertices, remove a vertex with its faces, or create and delete triangular faces.
Los cambios de vértices y caras quedan e: Vertex and face edits stay in a draft. Apply shape checks the complete solid before saving; Cancel keeps the previous roof. Undo shape and Redo shape review the draft.
La malla debe cerrar un volumen sin cara: The mesh must enclose a volume without duplicate, intersecting or zero-area faces. Each edge needs two consistently oriented faces. Complete the solid before applying.
Volver de Forma editada a una plantilla: Switching from Edited shape to a template asks you to confirm replacement. Finishes are kept; vertices and faces are replaced by the chosen template.
El interior sigue la cara inferior real: The interior follows the real roof underside. A sloped roof does not create an imaginary flat ceiling below it; headroom depends on that shape and existing slabs.
Abre Ajustes → Gráficos desde la bibliot: Open Settings → Graphics from the library or editor. Automatic adapts options to your device. You can pin one option and leave the rest on Automatic; Manual keeps your values.
Puedes ajustar sombras, resolución de te: You can adjust shadows, texture resolution, render scale, geometry detail, detail distance, contact shadows and the frame-rate limit.
Si el visor va lento, reduce la escala y: If the viewer slows down, reduce scale and shadows, use less detail and choose 30 frames per second. Standard also reduces material work compared with Realistic and Hyperrealistic.
Restablecer gráficos vuelve a la configu: Reset graphics returns to automatic settings. These preferences are stored only in this browser, without changing collaborators or other devices.
Calidad visual forma parte del diseño. G: Visual quality belongs to the design. Graphics controls local performance and can have different values on each device.
Abre Materiales o selecciona una pared,: Open Materials or select a wall, floor or ceiling. Wall side lets you change the Left side or Right side separately. Apply to all walls reuses the color on the chosen side.
En Opciones de vista → Calidad visual el: In View options → Visual quality, choose Standard, Realistic or Hyperrealistic. The latter two add surface and lighting detail. Graphics in Settings tunes performance without changing the visual quality saved with the design.
La preparación descarga todos los nivele: Preparation downloads every level of your private designs, the reference images for each story, their models and your model library. A design with collaborators, pending invitations or a public link needs an independent personal copy.
Archivo → Descargar copia guarda un arch: File → Download copy saves a .3dspace file containing every level, reference image and GLB in the design. On mobile, these actions are in View options. Keep the file outside browser storage.
Archivo → Abrir proyecto acepta el paque: File → Open project accepts the current 3D Space package. The document and all its files are validated before import is applied. Earlier formats and standalone JSON are not accepted; a failed import keeps the previous design.
La construcción se confirma como una ope: Construction is confirmed as a complete operation. If another person changes the structure before your confirmation, review the warning and keep or recover your work before retrying.
En la vista 3D del editor de cubierta, e: In the roof editor 3D view, choose Vertices or Faces and use Move, Rotate or Scale. Select multiple lets you edit a group. Grid snapping and numeric coordinates help position the shape precisely. Fit roof centers the view.
Si cancelas un borrador modificado, conf: If you cancel a modified draft, confirm Discard changes or use Keep editing. If the shared roof changes or your permission is revoked while editing, the draft is not applied over the new version; Recover draft lets you copy its geometry.
Si se interrumpe la conexión o cambia tu: If the connection drops or your access changes while drawing or dragging, the pending outline or movement is paused. Resume outline or Apply pending movement requires restored access and a compatible base. Recover draft lets you copy its coordinates before closing the view.
Si un cambio compartido es rechazado, Ca: If a shared change is rejected, Recovered changes keeps a private copy of the design on this device for your account. You can reopen it before discarding it, provided the browser retains its data.
Descargar copia necesita los archivos de: Download copy needs the design files. It may fail if you no longer have access to a model or reference image. In Recover draft you can always copy the design data; that JSON keeps its structure, but does not include files and is not an importable package. Save the copy before discarding changes.
Techo selecciona la cara interior que qu: Ceiling selects the interior face above the active level: the underside of the upper slab or roof. Its color and material are independent of the floor above it and the roof exterior finish.
Abre la muestra de color para ajustar to: Open the color swatch to adjust hue, saturation and brightness, enter a hexadecimal color or RGB values from 0 to 255. Previous shows the opening color; New shows your preview. Copy the hexadecimal value or reuse design colors, including furniture and stairs. Apply saves one change; Cancel, Escape or tapping outside discards the preview.
Al abrir, la aplicación se actualiza aut: On opening, the app updates automatically if you have not started working and no tab has pending work. During a working session, Update available offers Update now or Remind me later; you can also update from Settings. Finish or cancel fields, colors and drawings and save models before updating. Pending work already saved on the device is preserved without requiring synchronization. Returning from the background does not reload your work. Offline mode does not check for or apply updates.
Croquis carga una referencia PNG, JPG o: Sketch loads a PNG, JPG or WebP reference up to 10 MiB, 8192 pixels per side and 16 million pixels in total for the active level. Each level can have a different image. Images are not automatically converted to walls. Remove sketch keeps the construction.
Cada cuenta admite 50 diseños y 500 MiB: Each account supports 50 designs and 500 MiB of content. The model library supports up to 100 models and 100 MiB within that total. If you reach a limit, you can open, export or delete content to free space; pending local changes are preserved.
Los menús Habitación y Opciones del nive: The Room and Level options menus close after choosing, tapping outside or pressing Escape. Use arrow keys to move through actions and Escape to return to the button. Dragging preserves the grab point; adding a second finger cancels the provisional movement so you can navigate without moving it.
Si cierras con la X o Escape mientras ha: If you close with X or Escape while changes remain, the workshop asks you to confirm Discard changes. Keep editing preserves pieces and history. Apply or cancel any color preview before saving or updating.
Si una pestaña tiene otra versión de la: If a tab has a different application version, update before starting new edits. You can view and export designs; previous work remains saved.
Necesitas dos niveles consecutivos. Sele: You need two consecutive levels. Select the lower level and open Add → Staircases. Choose Straight, Straight with landing, L-shaped, U-shaped or Spiral. During setup, open Staircases in Sketch or choose Staircases in Furniture.
Selecciona la escalera en la escena o en: Select a staircase in the scene or Items and select Edit to open its properties. You can change width, step count, tread depth, position and rotation. Total height comes from the connected levels; Riser shows each step height.
Pulsa Agregar en la barra del visor, tam: Select Add in the viewer toolbar, including on mobile. Choose a bed, wardrobe, vanity, nightstand, door, window, light, staircase or custom model. Furniture and stair categories offer different shapes.
Catálogo de escaleras con cinco formas p: Stair catalog with five shapes to connect two levels.
Agregar → Escaleras reúne las cinco form: Add → Staircases contains all five shapes; select one to add it to the design.
